displayPattern: Front-load washer display shows Sud or Sd
meaning: Too many suds: the washer cannot spin out water with excess suds, so it extends the rinse and pauses tumbling to let the bubbles break.
causes: "No splash" or "easy pour" liquid chlorine bleach (it contains a thickening agent that can create suds)
diySteps: Let the pause and extra rinse run; it may happen several times to clear the suds
Make sure you are using HE (high efficiency) detergent
If you used "no splash" or "easy pour" liquid chlorine bleach, run the washer with regular liquid bleach instead
Make sure the drain hose is not kinked or clogged
safetyNote: Unplug the washer (or switch off its breaker) and close the water taps before you reach behind it, handle hoses or open a filter. Water left from a recent hot cycle can be very hot, so let it cool first. Never bypass the door lock. Motor, pump, valve, sensor and control-board repairs belong to a qualified appliance technician.
proAdvice: This is usually a detergent or drain-hose issue; if it persists, contact Whirlpool or schedule service online.
